text:
In which situation is the wavelength of the wave changed?
A
light from the Sun passing from air into water
B
radio waves travelling from an Earth satellite to the Moon
C
sound reflecting from a wall
D
water waves passing through a narrow gap

options.label: A
options.text: light from the Sun passing from air into water

options.label: B
options.text: radio waves travelling from an Earth satellite to the Moon

options.label: D
options.text: water waves passing through a narrow gap
